_note: Original to Arda. Stat blocks and classes are SRD 5.1 names (CC-BY-4.0).

ruler.title: {title} of {realm}
ruler.duties: Rules the realm from its seat, hears the great lords and decides war and peace.

lord.title: {title} of {settlement}
lord.duties: Holds the settlement from the ruler, keeps the peace and collects the levy.

reeve.title: Reeve of {settlement}
reeve.duties: Answers to the lord for the village's dues and labour days.

elder.title: Elder of {settlement}
elder.duties: Settles quarrels and speaks for the hamlet when anyone asks.

steward.title: Steward of {settlement}
steward.duties: Runs the ruler's household, accounts and granaries.

captain.title: Captain of the {settlement} Watch
captain.duties: Commands the watch and the garrison; holds the gates.

high_priest.title: High Priest of {settlement}
high_priest.duties: Leads the temple, its rites, tithes and charity.

abbot.title: Prior of {settlement} Abbey
abbot.duties: Governs the abbey, its lands, scriptorium and brethren.

shrine_keeper.title: Keeper of the {settlement} Shrine
shrine_keeper.duties: Tends the shrine and keeps the feast days.

harbourmaster.title: Harbourmaster of {settlement}
harbourmaster.duties: Assigns berths, collects harbour dues and watches the tides.

mine_overseer.title: Overseer of the {settlement} Mines
mine_overseer.duties: Runs the workings for their owner and answers for every cart of ore.

court_mage.title: Court Mage of {realm}
court_mage.duties: Advises the ruler on things arcane and keeps the realm's library.

spymaster.title: Spymaster of {realm}
spymaster.duties: Keeps the ruler's secrets and learns everyone else's.

guildmaster.title: Master of the {settlement} Merchants
guildmaster.duties: Leads the merchant guild and sets the market rules.

craftmaster.title: Master of the {settlement} Craft Guild
craftmaster.duties: Leads the craft guild, examines masterpieces and fines cheats.

crime_boss.title: Boss of the {settlement} underworld
crime_boss.duties: Runs the gang: smuggling, protection and fencing.

fisher_head.title: Headman of the {settlement} Fishers
fisher_head.duties: Speaks for the boats and shares out the fishing grounds.

miner_captain.title: Captain of the {settlement} Delvers
miner_captain.duties: Leads the miners' brotherhood below ground and at the pay table.

forester.title: Chief Woodward of {settlement}
forester.duties: Leads the woodfolk and knows every path in the forest.

boatmaster.title: Master of the {settlement} Lightermen
boatmaster.duties: Leads the quay porters and lightermen.

commons_voice.title: Voice of the {settlement} Commons
commons_voice.duties: Speaks for the common folk at moots and to the lord.
